大伙儿都叫他“可怕的巧克力强
dào”。
盗”。

[P3] 那天，一清早，可怕的巧克力强盗
又出门打劫去了。

傍晚时分，他吹着口哨在森林里
走着。这一天的收获真不小，他抢到
了一只巧克力的小鸟和一个巧克力的
士兵。当然，小鸟和士兵都进了强盗
大大的嘴巴。

多么贪心的巧克力强盗！

巧克力强盗向着夕阳走啊，走
啊，他看见不远处有幢小木头房子，
小房子前有个美丽的小花园，小花园
外面有一道白色的木栅栏。

巧克力强盗翻过白色的栅栏，穿
过美丽的花园，来到小屋边的台阶上。

他踮起脚尖，伸长脖子，朝屋子里张
望。

此时，巧克力强盗想的是，要是
屋子里有巧克力该多好，他可以饱餐

[P4] 一顿，然后安心地上床睡觉了。
这一觉一定能睡得美美的，说不定还会做一个挺美挺美的巧克力梦……
可是，屋子里没有巧克力，只有两个小孩子。一个是胖胖的小男孩，一个是瘦瘦的小女孩。
胖胖的小男孩在哭。
瘦瘦的小女孩在安慰他。
小男孩抽抽搭搭地说：“这是我奶奶送给我的生日礼物，一个多么神气的巧克力兵，我本来要和它做个伴儿，听它讲很多巧克力故事的。可是，它现在进了巧克力强盗的肚子里了。”

[P5] “要知道，”小男孩抹了一把眼泪
说，“我也是很喜欢吃巧克力的啊，可
我舍不得吃它！”
小女孩用她那银铃般的嗓音说：
“哪个小孩不喜欢吃巧克力，女孩子尤
其喜欢巧克力。我哥哥送给我一只巧
克力小鸟，他写信告诉我说，‘当你吃
巧克力小鸟时，别忘了写信告诉我，
它是什么味儿的，我是舍不得才给
你的……’可是现在呢，小鸟进了巧克
力强盗的嘴，谁知道它是什么味儿的
呢？”
小女孩拿出了手绢，说：“一想到
这里，我也想哭呢。”
就在这时，响起了很响的哭声。
小男孩和小女孩
吓了一大跳——
他们仔细一听，这
不是他们自己的哭声。
这是一种声音很粗，嗓子很哑，
幼儿很大的哭声，好像是从窗外传
进来的。
哇！！！

[P6] 小女孩和小男孩飞快地冲过去，打开门来一看。
他们惊呆了——
门外的台阶上，坐着巧克力强盗，他用两只手支着头，正在那儿嚎啕大哭呢。
眼泪从他那有着黑黑的眼珠子的眼眶里流下来，流过了红鼻子，流过了蓝胡子，一滴一滴地滴在台阶上，台阶上湿了一大片。
那顶咖啡色的破帽子呢，随着他的哭泣，在他的头上一上一下地跳着舞。
哭声很让人伤心。

[P7] 小女孩也跟着哭起
来了，她用很好听的声音说：“强盗伯
伯……”可她再一想，怎么可以叫强
盗“伯伯”呢，就改口说：“强盗先生，
你为什么那么伤心？”
小男孩也用同样的声音说：“要
不要我送条毛巾给你？”
“不用。”强盗用他那可怜巴巴的
眼睛看着两个孩子说，“我只需要你们
的原谅！”
两个孩子被弄糊涂了。
巧克力强盗抽搭了一
下说：“我以前只知道我爱
吃巧克力，不知道你们还
有所有的孩子都是那么爱吃
巧克力。”
“我们都非常爱吃巧克力！”两个
孩子异口同声地说。
巧克力强盗抹了一把眼泪继续
说：“我每次抢来巧克力，就把它们吞
下肚，我不知道巧克力还是一些珍贵
的礼物和纪念品，它们里面还藏着这

[P8] 样那样的故事……”
“是的，每块巧克力都有它自己的
故事！”两个孩子点点头说。
“唉，”强盗长长地叹了一口气
说，“我今天才知道，我是个多么坏，多
么狠心的强盗，我抢掉孩子们的巧克
力，我吃掉了他们珍贵的礼物和纪念
品，还有关于它们有趣的故事……”
巧克力强盗哭
得更伤心了。
小男孩和小女
孩不得不安慰强盗：“你知道错了就
好，我们会原谅你的，我们把今天被你
抢走的巧克力，作为礼物送给你吧，
请你永远记住这两块巧克力和它们
的故事。”
巧克力强盗使劲地点点头，他拥
抱了两个孩子。

[P9] 他胡子上的泪水，把两个孩子的
头发都打湿了。
一连好多天，人们都没看见巧克力
强盗在森林里游荡。
小男孩和小女孩有可能记巧克力
强盗了。

一天，阳光灿烂。小男孩和
小女孩正在屋里玩。忽然，他们发
现，小窗台上的花瓶边上，站着
一个漂亮威武的巧克力士兵，还站
着一只美丽的巧克力小鸟。

[P2] sēn lín lǐ, yǒu le qiángdào——
In the forest, there was a robber—

lā zhǎng zhe lán hú zi, hóng bí zi, hēi hēi de
He had blue whiskers, a red nose, and black eyes.
yǎn zhū zi, tóu shàng hái dài zhe yī dǐng kā fēi sè de pò
His eyes were black, and on his head he wore a broken, coffee-colored hat.
mào zi.
hat.

zhè gè qiángdào zuì xǐ huān chī qiǎo kè lì。
This robber loved chocolate the most.
lá shén me huó er yě bú xiǎng gàn, zhěng
He didn’t want to do any work at all, and spent his whole day...

tiān zài sēn lín lǐ yóu dàng
wandering around in the forest.

zhǐ yào kàn dào shuí yǒu qiǎo kè lì, tā jiù shǐ jìn de
As soon as he saw anyone with chocolate, he would rush after them,
zhuī shàng qù, fēi bǎ qiǎo kè lì qiáng dào shǒu bù kě
determined to steal it no matter what.

dà huǒ er dōu jiào tā “kě pà de qiǎo kè lì qiáng
Everyone called him “the terrifying chocolate robber.”
dào”.
robber.

[P3] That morning, the terrible chocolate thief
went out to rob again.

In the evening, he was whistling as he walked through the forest.
He had a great harvest that day—he stole
a chocolate bird and a chocolate soldier.
Of course, the bird and the soldier both went into the thief's
big, big mouth.

How greedy the chocolate thief is!

The chocolate thief walked toward the sunset, walking
and walking. He saw a small wooden house not far away.
In front of the small house was a beautiful little garden, and outside the garden
there was a white wooden fence.

The chocolate thief climbed over the white fence, walked
through the beautiful garden, and arrived at the steps beside the small house.

He tiptoed, stretched his neck, and looked
inside the house.

At this moment, the chocolate thief was thinking: if
there were chocolate inside the house, how wonderful it would be—he could feast

[P4] After a meal, he went to bed and slept peacefully.
This sleep would surely be wonderful, and maybe he'd even have a lovely chocolate dream...
But there was no chocolate in the house—only two children. One was a chubby little boy, and the other was a thin little girl.
The chubby boy was crying.
The thin girl was comforting him.
The boy sniffled, "This was a birthday gift from my grandma—a super cool chocolate soldier. I was going to be his buddy and listen to him tell lots of chocolate stories. But now... it's inside the chocolate robber's stomach!"

[P5] "You know," the little boy wiped a tear and said, "I also really like eating chocolate, but I can't bear to eat it!"

The little girl spoke in her silvery voice: "Which child doesn't like chocolate? Girls especially love it. My brother gave me a chocolate bird. He wrote to me, 'When you eat the chocolate bird, don't forget to write to me and tell me what flavor it is. I couldn't bear to give it to you... But now, the bird is in the chocolate thief's mouth. Who knows what flavor it is?'

The little girl took out her handkerchief and said, "Just thinking about this makes me want to cry too."

At that moment, a loud crying sound rang out.

The little boy and girl
jumped in surprise—
They listened carefully. This
wasn't their own crying.

It was a rough, hoarse voice,
a loud cry of a child, as if coming
from outside the window.

Wah!!!

[P6] The little girl and the little boy rushed over quickly and opened the door to take a look.
They were stunned—
On the steps outside, the chocolate thief was sitting, holding his head with both hands, sobbing loudly.
Tears streamed from his eyes with black pupils, flowing over his red nose, over his blue beard, dripping one by one onto the steps, soaking a big patch of them.
What about that coffee-colored broken hat? It bounced up and down on his head with his crying.
The crying sound was very heartbreaking.

[P7] The little girl started crying too.
She said in a very pleasant voice, "Uncle Robber..." But then she thought, how could she call the robber "Uncle"? So she changed her tone and said, "Mr. Robber, why are you so sad?"
The little boy also said in the same voice, "Shall I give you a towel?"
"No need," the robber said with his pitiful eyes looking at the two children, "I just need your forgiveness!"
The two children were confused.
The chocolate robber sniffled and said, "I used to know only that I loved chocolate, but I didn't know that you, and all children, love chocolate so much."
"We all love chocolate very much!" the two children said in unison.
The chocolate robber wiped a tear and continued, "Every time I stole chocolate, I just swallowed it whole. I didn't know chocolate was also precious gifts and souvenirs, and that inside them were hidden..."

[P8] Such stories...”
“Yes, every piece of chocolate has its own
story!” the two children nodded.
“Ah,” the robber sighed deeply,
saying, “Today I finally realized how bad and
how cruel I’ve been. I stole chocolate from children,
I ate their precious gifts and mementos,
and I destroyed the fun stories connected to them…”
The chocolate robber cried
even more sadly.
Boy and girl
The children couldn’t help but comfort the robber: “You’ve realized your mistake,
that’s good. We’ll forgive you. We’ll give back the chocolate we took today,
as a gift. Please always remember these two pieces of chocolate and their
stories.”
The chocolate robber nodded vigorously, then
hugged the two children.

[P9] The tears on his mustache soaked the children's hair.
For many days, no one had seen the chocolate thief wandering in the forest.
The boy and girl might remember the chocolate thief.

One day, the sun was shining brightly. The boy and girl were playing inside the house. Suddenly, they noticed, on the windowsill beside the vase, stood a handsome and brave chocolate soldier, and also stood a beautiful chocolate bird.

full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本的章节标题页，显示第二章的标题为“哭泣的巧克力强盗”，并附有拼音注释。
[P2] 本页介绍了森林里出现了一个喜欢吃巧克力的强盗，他长着蓝胡子、红鼻子、黑眼睛，戴着破帽子，整天游荡，只要看到巧克力就抢，因此被大家称为“可怕的巧克力强盗”。
[P3] 本页描述了巧克力强盗在傍晚时分抢劫后，继续游荡并发现了一座小木屋，他翻过栅栏、穿过花园，来到屋前台阶上，踮起脚尖张望，心里想着如果屋内有巧克力该多好。
[P4] 巧克力强盗闯入小木屋，发现屋内没有巧克力，只有两个正在哭泣的孩子。胖男孩因心爱的巧克力兵被抢而伤心，瘦女孩在一旁安慰他。
[P5] 小男孩和小女孩在小木屋里哭泣，回忆自己心爱的巧克力被强盗抢走，这时突然听到窗外传来一个粗哑、巨大的幼儿哭声，两人吓了一跳。
[P6] 小女孩和小男孩打开门，发现巧克力强盗正坐在台阶上嚎啕大哭，眼泪流了一地，破帽子也随着哭泣在头上跳动，哭声令人心疼。
[P7] 巧克力强盗在小木屋前哭泣，两个孩子被他的哭声吓到并上前关心。强盗向孩子们解释自己伤心的原因，承认自己只知抢夺巧克力却不知其珍贵，孩子们则异口同声表示自己也爱吃巧克力，强盗因此感到愧疚并请求原谅。
[P8] 巧克力强盗向两个孩子忏悔，承认自己抢夺巧克力的行为是错误的，并为破坏了巧克力背后的故事而感到伤心。孩子们原谅了他，并将巧克力作为礼物送还给他，强盗感动地拥抱了他们。
[P9] 本页描述巧克力强盗因哭泣而泪水打湿了孩子们的头发，之后他消失多日，孩子们开始记起他。画面切换到一个阳光灿烂的日子，小男孩和小女孩在屋里玩耍，发现窗台上有一个巧克力士兵和一只巧克力小鸟。
[P10] 画面左侧描绘了小男孩在草地上行走，右侧是黄色背景的对话框，内有文字和两个小角色（巧克力士兵和巧克力小鸟）的插图，文字内容为对巧克力士兵和小鸟的描述，以及它们在巧克力世界中的活动。
[P11] 巧克力强盗急匆匆地离开，帽子在头上颠簸，两个孩子高声向他道谢。强盗回头时，孩子们看到他黑黑的眼珠、大大的红鼻子和随着笑声抖动的蓝胡子。
